title: Scalable iterative Gramian synthesis for control-affine systems
summary: This article presents a scalable implementation of nonlinear Gramian-based control synthesis for control-affine systems, including a minimum energy control construction. These synthesis advances are achieved by addressing key computational bottlenecks inherent to iterative synthesis map formulations, yielding a computational scheme that exhibits rapid convergence and high-precision. The efficacy of this synthesis framework is demonstrated across five canonical nonlinear control systems and 100-dimensional recurrent neural network models, including underactuated systems.
